audit.whatIsWrong: All seven chart rows disagreed with the mirror, giving Darius five stages against a 57.46% Heimerdinger win rate — and levels 1-2 were scored to Darius while their own whys text says he cannot all-in a yordle farming from beam range.
audit.why: Darius has no gap-closer until Apprehend, which is 535 range on 26s at rank 1, while Heimerdinger's rockets reach 1325. The mirror set Heimerdinger / Heimerdinger / Darius / Skill / Darius / Skill / Heimerdinger.
audit.corrected: Chart aligned to the mirror on both layers with ratings moved to match; difficulty re-rated 5.5/10 to agree with the FAV label.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level-6 row named no ultimate and the whole page carried no cooldown sequencing at all — the packet flags exactly this defect.
audit.why: Noxian Guillotine is 120/100/80 true damage that scales off Hemorrhage stacks and refreshes on a kill; Apprehend is 26/23.5/21/18.5/16s; CH-2 is a flat 11s. Those three numbers give the concrete 'hold X until he spends Y' line the page was missing.
audit.corrected: Hold CH-2's 11s for his 26s Apprehend; when the pull whiffs the whole wave is free; never sit at low HP once Guillotine is up.

audit.whatIsWrong: The grenade was called 'CH-3X Lightning Grenade' with a 'center stun', the turret beams were credited with a slow, and 'empowered-Q outer ring' misdescribed Decimate.
audit.why: Heimerdinger's E is CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade — 11s flat, 970 range — stunning only the unit hit directly and slowing those around it. The turret's secondary attack is a pass-through beam with no slow. Riot's Decimate text says enemies struck by the blade take more damage than those struck by the handle, and Darius heals off blade hits — there is no empowerment mechanic.
audit.corrected: Land CH-2's direct hit on the Apprehend frame; clip the edge and it is only a slow. Stay out of the Decimate blade edge, which is also what heals him.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing warned that Crippling Strike is an auto-attack reset.
audit.why: His slow arrives on an attack reset, so the auto wind-up is the cue to step back, not the ability cast.
audit.corrected: React to the auto wind-up rather than the cast when he steps into the nest.

edits.before: Darius wants exactly one thing early: to land E and drag you off your turrets into the empowered-Q outer ring where his sweet-spot lands. Don't give it to him — plant your H-28G turrets behind the wave and last-hit from inside their beam range, never stepping up to where his E arc reaches. At Level 1 you have one turret and no grenade, so concede that first walk-up and just farm; by Level 2-3 a second turret plus the stacked slowing beams make his approach cost real chip every time, and Hemorrhage poke can't out-trade three buildings chunking him on entry.
edits.after: Darius wants exactly one thing early: to land Apprehend and drag you off your turrets into the Decimate blade edge where his sweet-spot lands. Don't give it to him — plant your H-28G turrets behind the wave and last-hit from inside their beam range, never stepping inside the 535 range his pull reaches. At Level 1 you have one turret and no grenade, so concede that first walk-up and just farm; by Level 2-3 a second turret plus the stacked beams make his approach cost real chip, and Hemorrhage poke can't out-trade three buildings.

edits.before: Once CH-3X Lightning Grenade is up this is the coin-flip you usually win: Darius has to E-pull to start anything, and if you hold the grenade for that exact frame, the center stun locks him inside your nest while three beams and W rockets melt him before Hemorrhage stacks ever matter. The danger is whiffing it — a missed center stun means he pulls, empowered-Qs the outer ring, and your squishy yordle evaporates. At 6 your UPGRADE!!! grenade stuns wider and longer, so bait his Flash-E and punish it; just respect that the Guillotine still executes you the one time he gets a clean pull off the structures.
edits.after: Once CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade is up this is the coin-flip you usually win: Darius has to Apprehend to start anything, and if you hold the grenade for that exact frame, the direct-hit stun locks him inside your nest while three beams and W rockets melt him before Hemorrhage stacks ever matter. The danger is whiffing it — clip the edge and it is only a slow, so he pulls, blade-edges you, and your squishy yordle evaporates for the full 11s. At 6 your UPGRADE!!! grenade stuns wider and longer, so bait his Flash-Apprehend and punish it; just respect that Guillotine's true damage still executes you the one time he gets a clean pull.

notes: Noxian Guillotine is true damage, so the existing 'build MR' style advice would be wrong here — the itemization line already leads with Liandry's and anti-heal, which is correct against Decimate's blade healing. The mirror notes that 'CH-3X-fire his turrets' corresponds to nothing in Riot's data for Heimerdinger; the same fabricated grenade name appears across every matchup in this slice.
